verdict.rationale: The evidence hints at product-native multi-record actions: statement reminders can go to multiple late-paying customers in a few clicks, and QBO Advanced can sync spreadsheet data to cut manual work. Neither is explicitly documented as a general bulk or batch operation, and the MCP server's per-entity CRUD tools are building blocks rather than bulk actions. Missing for 10: explicit bulk or batch edit, update and delete across many records; documented batch API or agent bulk tooling; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: In just a few clicks you can send statement reminders to customers that are late paying you.
QuickBooks Online Advanced can sync data in spreadsheets to reduce your manual work.
